driver.text: Nasdaq futures fell more than 2% as Amazon (-7.2% premarket) and Intel (-25%) reported results: Amazon showed a sharp third-quarter cash outflow and signaled higher capex next year; Intel warned it would burn cash this year. Alphabet was down 0.9% after Thursday's record selloff. Futures data as of 4:04 AM ET. Per Reuters, the Fed held rates steady earlier this week and a hike is widely expected as soon as December.

items.headline: Circle froze more than $800 million of assets tied to the $6.3B Binance hack
items.summary: About half of the stolen assets were frozen by stablecoin issuers; Circle froze more than $800 million and Tether nearly $1.57 billion. Binance halted withdrawals and said it expects to resume within 48 hours. Relevant to USDC issuer actions and crypto-market sentiment; Circle's share move is not stated in the source.
